Name: (CP) Pam in Shipping Bin
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Updated for 1.6![/b][/size]

With this mod, the infamous Pam will lurk in your shipping bin. When you ship an item, she'll pop out and back in, hoping you'll throw her a Beer or two. (You still get money out of the deal, so why not help an old gal out?)

~~

Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod[/url], this mod adds Pam into your shipping bin. When you ship an item, she'll pop out and back inside. Purely cosmetic and for fun; rest assured that your products and profits are entirely safe.

Works with buildable shipping bins around the farm, and overlays over other shipping bin colors--like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Eemie's Dark Wood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]my Burnt Sienna[/url]~

Note however that this mod does [b]not [/b]work with anything that affects the shipping bin animation itself--such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿. 

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and behold the legendary Pam![/font]
